explanation: To express admiration and gratitude to God for his goodness and greatness.
A title showing respect and reverence for God, often used as a substitute for God's name in the Old Testament.
A reference to God as the ancestor of Jacob, one of Israel's patriarchs and forefathers of the twelve tribes of Israel.
The spiritual realm where God reigns, and where faithful people will spend eternity with him.
A person or divine being who rescues others from danger, suffering, or destruction. In Psalm 146, it refers to God as protector and helper of his people.
A woman who has lost her spouse through death and has not remarried.
A person who has lost their father, often used to describe children without caregivers or support.
A metaphor for life's journey and the choices and actions we make throughout our lives.
